title: Just okay
text:
Just okay. This is a really interesting “seat”/“saddle”. It is sort of awkward to use initially. You have to be careful using it in an office setting to make sure your knees and legs are at 90 degree angles, this lifts you up a lot and can change the angle you’re sitting at that makes it not ergonomic.

We work in a therapy office with OTs and they typically just use this for kids who fidget in a seat or to work on core strength. This is really like a bumpy seat but more expensive and shaped.
